name: React Vite Starter
summary: Vite + React + TypeScript starter with shadcn/ui, Redux Toolkit, RTK Query, Storybook and testing preconfigured.
description: A batteries-included starter for building React apps with Vite, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. It pairs shadcn/ui components and Storybook with React Router, Redux Toolkit and RTK Query for state and data fetching, Zod validation and react-i18next for internationalization. Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, ESLint, Prettier, Husky and Commitizen come configured, plus a multi-stage Docker build.
contains: shadcn/ui components with a Storybook workshop
Redux Toolkit and RTK Query, React Router, Zod
Vitest, React Testing Library and Playwright configured
ESLint, Prettier, Husky, Commitizen and Commitlint
multi-stage Docker build served by nginx
